name: Airport & city transport
description: Reach your accommodation and move between places.
check: Compare the full route, luggage rules, operating hours and final connection.

name: Private guides & tours
description: Arrange a guided outing around your interests.
check: Confirm guide arrangements, language, itinerary, inclusions and cancellation terms.

name: Cooking & experiences
description: Book a hands-on activity with a clear schedule.
check: Confirm dietary needs, pickup zone, class size, duration and what is included.

name: SIM & mobile data
check: Check device compatibility, registration, activation, plan validity and data limits.

name: Luggage storage
description: Leave bags between check-out and departure.
check: Check the exact location, opening and retrieval time, baggage limits and terms.

name: Hotels & stays
description: Compare accommodation by the trip you want.
check: Check room category, total cost, location and cancellation policy.

name: Restaurants & dining
description: Choose a meal by cuisine, group needs and location.
check: Read the current menu, dietary options, booking terms and payment methods.

name: Shops & local markets
description: Find gifts, craft browsing and practical purchases.
check: Check the branch or market session, product details, prices and returns.
